description: Resource Type definition for AWS::CloudFront::FieldLevelEncryptionProfile. A field-level encryption profile maps CloudFront public keys and provider identities to the request-body field patterns that CloudFront encrypts with them.

EncryptionEntity.description: A public key, its provider identity, and the field patterns CloudFront encrypts with that key.

PublicKeyId.description: The identifier of the CloudFront public key used to encrypt the fields that match the patterns.
PublicKeyId.markdownDescription:
The identifier of the CloudFront public key used to encrypt the fields that match the patterns.

Type: String

ProviderId.description: The provider associated with the public key. The same value must be supplied with the private key for an application to decrypt the data.
ProviderId.markdownDescription:

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Update requires: No interruption

FieldPatterns.description: The request-body field names to encrypt. A pattern is either a full field name or leading characters followed by a wildcard (*). Patterns are case-sensitive and must not overlap.
